opts = ['-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=10']
name = m['name']
D = B / name
assert not D.exists() and not (B / (name + '-transport.json')).exists()
for key in ('archive', 'script'):
    assert hashlib.file_digest((B / m[key]).open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest() == m[key + '_sha256']
subprocess.run(['scp', *opts, str(B / m['archive']), str(B / m['script']),
    'gb10-4t:<reference-host>/'], check=True, timeout=60)
command = ['ssh', *opts, 'gb10-4t', 'python3 <reference-host>/' + m['script']]
started = time.monotonic()
try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=m['ssh_timeout_seconds'])
    record = dict(command=command, returncode=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
        stderr=result.stderr, wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
    record = dict(command=command, returncode=None, timeout=True,
        stdout=(error.stdout or b'').decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(error.stdout, bytes) else error.stdout,
        stderr=(error.stderr or b'').decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(error.stderr, bytes) else error.stderr,
        wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    with (B / (name + '-transport.json')).open('x') as f: json.dump(record, f, indent=2); f.write('\n')
    raise
with (B / (name + '-transport.json')).open('x') as f: json.dump(record, f, indent=2); f.write('\n')
print('reference_dispatch', result.returncode, result.stdout[-4500:], result.stderr[-2000:], flush=True)
metadata = json.loads(result.stdout.splitlines()[-1])

archive = B / (name + '-compact.tar.gz')

    str(archive)], check=True, timeout=180)
assert archive.stat().st_size == metadata['compact_archive_bytes']
assert hashlib.file_digest(archive.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest() == metadata['compact_archive_sha256']
D.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
 members=tar.getmembers();assert len(members)<12000 and sum(m.size for m in members)<1250*(1<<20)
 assert all(m.isfile() and not Path(m.name).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(m.name).parts for m in members)
 tar.extractall(D, filter='data')
manifest = json.loads((D / 'compact-download-manifest.json').read_text())
for relative, expected in manifest.items():
    p = D / relative
    assert p.stat().st_size == expected['bytes']
    assert hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest() == expected['sha256'], relative
print('compact_files_verified', len(manifest), flush=True)
result.check_returncode()

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import random
import struct

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P = Path('<runtime-checkout>')
name = 'qrt-gb10-real-q8192-prefill-20260921-r1'
D = B / name
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
identity = lambda p: dict(file=str(p.relative_to(B)), bytes=p.stat().st_size, sha256=sha(p))
plan = read(B / (name + '-stage.json'))
dispatch = read(D / 'dispatch.json')
assert dispatch['source_commit'] == plan['source_commit']
assert dispatch['command_file_sha256'] == plan['script_sha256']
assert dispatch['returncode'] == 0 and dispatch['reason'] == 'completed'
assert dispatch['host_guard_pass'] and not dispatch['gpu_processes_after']
assert dispatch['container_status'] == 'false 0'
assert dispatch['reference_boundary_qualified'] and dispatch['original_matrix_reproduced']
assert dispatch['original_operand_window_qualified'] and dispatch['frozen_autotune_cache_no_misses']
assert sha(D / 'source-inputs.json') == plan['source_inputs_sha256']
assert sha(D / 'frozen-autotune-profile.json') == plan['frozen_autotune_profile_sha256']
assert sha(D / 'scripts/capture_gb10_runtime_boundaries.py') == plan['boundary_observer_sha256']
assert sha(D / 'scripts/capture_gb10_token_matrix.py') == plan['capture_script_sha256']
for relative, value in read(D / 'compact-download-manifest.json').items():
    path = D / relative
    assert path.stat().st_size == value['bytes'] and sha(path) == value['sha256']
capture = read(D / 'capture/capture.json')
original_path = P / 'contracts/gb10_cold_token_matrix_20260911_oracle.json'
assert sha(original_path) == '7a6feb488f4dd136e49c4d7227c1fc325e3216af3dae3e9b60aa0b3025f3d1b1'
original = read(original_path)
assert capture['completed'] and capture['controls_qualified'] and len(capture['cases']) == 8
cases = []
for expected, actual in zip(original['cases'], capture['cases'], strict=True):
    assert actual['name'] == expected['name']
    assert all(actual['prompt'][key] == expected['prompt'][key] for key in (
        'token_count', 'seed', 'first_token_id', 'u32le_sha256', 'u32le_fnv1a64'))
    boundary = expected['expected']
    assert actual['output_token_ids'] == boundary['output_token_ids']
    assert actual['first_token_id'] == boundary['first_token_id']
    worker = actual['worker']
    path = D / 'capture' / actual['name'] / worker['file']
    assert path.stat().st_size == worker['bytes'] == 248320 * 2
    assert sha(path) == worker['sha256'] and worker['shape'] == [1,248320]
    assert worker['dtype'] == 'torch.bfloat16' and not worker['observer_modifies_output']
    values = [struct.unpack('<f', struct.pack('<I', word << 16))[0]
              for (word,) in struct.iter_unpack('<H', path.read_bytes())]
    assert all(not math.isnan(v) and v != math.inf for v in values)
    winner = max(range(len(values)), key=values.__getitem__)
    value = values[winner]
    assert winner == actual['first_token_id'] == worker['raw_argmax_token']
    assert value == actual['first_token_raw_logit'] == worker['raw_logit']
    error = abs(value - boundary['first_token_raw_logit'])
    assert math.isfinite(value) and error <= boundary['first_token_raw_logit_tolerance'] == 0.125
    assert actual['full_matrix_case_pass']
    cases.append(dict(name=actual['name'], prompt=actual['prompt'], outputs=actual['output_token_ids'],
        first_token=winner, first_logit=value, first_logit_absolute_error=error,
        raw_logits=identity(path), all_original_outputs_match=True,
        original_first_logits_hash_equal=worker['sha256'] == expected['raw_logits']['sha256']))
assert sum(len(c['outputs']) for c in cases) == 1216
case = next(c for c in capture['cases'] if c['name'] == 'q8192-out512')
prompt = case['prompt']
generator = random.Random(prompt['seed'])
ids = [prompt['first_token_id']] + [32 + generator.randrange(256) for _ in range(8191)]
assert hashlib.sha256(struct.pack('<8192I', *ids)).hexdigest() == prompt['u32le_sha256']
bounds = case['worker']['runtime_boundaries']
linear, attention = bounds['full_prefill_linear_window'], bounds['full_prefill_attention_window']
assert linear['plan'] == dict(layer=0, first_position=0, tokens=8192)
assert attention['plan'] == dict(layer=3, first_position=0, tokens=8192)
assert linear['projection_only'] and not linear['core_only']
assert linear['transaction'] == attention['transaction']
transaction = next(t for t in bounds['transactions'] if t['ordinal'] == linear['transaction'])
assert transaction['first_position'] == 0 and transaction['token_count'] == 8192
assert transaction['input_token_ids'] == ids and not transaction['discarded']
assert transaction['qualified_rows'] and all(r['matches_generated_history'] for r in transaction['qualified_rows'])
assert any(r['position'] == r['row'] == 8191 and r['input_token_id'] == ids[-1] for r in transaction['qualified_rows'])
shapes = {
    'full-prefill-layer-00-input-rmsnorm': [8192,2048],
    'full-prefill-linear-00-qkv': [8192,8192],
    **{'full-prefill-full-03-' + label: [8192,width] for label,width in (
        ('qkv',9216),('q-norm',4096),('k-norm',512),('q-rope',4096),('k-rope',512),
        ('context',4096),('gated',4096),('output',2048))},
    'full-prefill-full-03-cache-k': [8192,2,256],
    'full-prefill-full-03-cache-v': [8192,2,256]}
files = {v['label']: v for v in bounds['files'].values() if v['label'].startswith('full-prefill-')}
assert files.keys() == shapes.keys()
tensors = {}
for label, shape in shapes.items():
    value = files[label]
    assert value['transaction'] == transaction['ordinal'] and value['shape'] == shape and value['dtype'] == 'bf16'
    path = D / 'capture' / case['name'] / value['file']
    assert path.stat().st_size == value['bytes'] == math.prod(shape) * 2 and sha(path) == value['sha256']
    tensors[label] = dict(**identity(path), shape=shape, dtype='bf16', transaction=transaction['ordinal'])
assert tensors['full-prefill-full-03-cache-k']['sha256'] == tensors['full-prefill-full-03-k-rope']['sha256']
cache = attention['cache']
assert cache['tokens'] == cache['seq_lens'][0] == 8192 and cache['max_query_len'] == 8192
record = dict(kind='original_real_q8192_prefill_operands_gb10_reference',
    utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), host=dispatch['host'], model=capture['model'],
    source_commit=plan['source_commit'], observer_source_commit=plan['observer_source_commit'],
    dependency_source_commit=plan['dependency_source_commit'],
    plan=identity(B / (name + '-stage.json')), dispatch=identity(D / 'dispatch.json'),
    capture=identity(D / 'capture/capture.json'), original_token_matrix_sha256=sha(original_path),
    command=dispatch['command'], command_file=dispatch['command_file'], command_file_sha256=dispatch['command_file_sha256'],
    original_matrix_cases=cases, original_outputs=1216, original_outputs_match=True,
    reference_first_logit_tolerance=0.125, model_evidence=capture['model_evidence'],
    original_prefill_transaction=transaction, linear_window=linear, attention_window=attention,
    tensors=tensors, original_rows=8192, repeated_rows=0,
    full_attention_cache_key_equals_rope_key=True, reference_qualified=True,
    frozen_autotune_profile_sha256=plan['frozen_autotune_profile_sha256'],
    frozen_autotune_cache_no_misses=True, host_guard_pass=True, gpu_processes_after='',
    raw_first_logits_self_hash_is_acceptance_gate=False,
    analyzer=identity(Path(__file__)),
    windows_native_inference_executed=False, windows_acceptance=False,
    performance_acceptance=False, release_qualified=False)
out = D / 'boundary-analysis.json'
with out.open('x') as f:json.dump(record, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(file=str(out.relative_to(B)), sha256=sha(out), original_outputs=1216,
    tensor_count=len(tensors), tensor_bytes=sum(v['bytes'] for v in tensors.values()), original_rows=8192,
    reference_qualified=True)), flush=True)
